page.overview:
Who is Gennō's Son?

This boy was a citizen of Kagerō Village, and the son of Gennō.

Gennō and his son often went on scavenger hunts together. Thirty years prior to the start of the series, he died in a battle defending Kagerō Village. His father Gennō had warned him not to follow his example and become a ninja. When he died, Gennō blamed himself and decided to take revenge on Konohagakure. Gennō planted explosive tags all around the village, but he never detonated them because his village was destroyed.

According to Gennō, his son's personality was much like Naruto Uzumaki's.

Gennō's son bore a striking resemblance to Naruto, but his hair was smooth and long, and he wore a white t-shirt under a black vest jacket. He had blond hair.
